gatoh.logging.logging.LoggerVariables

class LoggerVariables(max_iterations: int, hierarchies: list[str])[source]

Dataclass that defines the simulation variables that are stored and tracked by the Logger.

Parameters:

  • max_iterations (int) – The maximum number of iterations that the model will run its simulation for.

  • hierarchies (list[str]) – The names of all social hierarchies present in the model.

Store the number of max iterations and initialise all lists and dictionaries with the appropriate hierarchy names and sizes to match the number of iterations.
